description: Retrieve the full gradient CSS recipe (linear angle, color stops, and semantic token values) for a specific gradient by gradientId. Call after list_gradients to materialize background styles or decorative surfaces on cards. Alternatives: Use list_gradients to search available recipes. Read-only platform catalog lookup. Returns full gradient recipe object.

gradientId.description: The unique identifier of the gradient preset (e.g. grad_warm_sunset).

name: get_gradient
title: Get gradient
